objective: Implement a clean C++ temporal orchestrator with no Python calls in its hot loop, pluggable state owners, declared channels and dated events, two-phase commit/rollback, and a MuJoCo C owner. Demonstrate that a model owner can be added without editing the orchestrator; do not claim complete fly fidelity or speed.

relation_to_rivals.A: Can install a multirate CNS owner with continuous/event current provider after its causal replay passes
relation_to_rivals.B: Can install partitioned QSS owners without changing scheduler code
relation_to_rivals.C: Can install JVP/Krylov owner if its cost/error gate passes
relation_to_rivals.F: Existing CUDA resident controller can be one owner; this prototype coordinates owner boundaries and MuJoCo

falsators: duplicate or unit-incompatible channel ownership is not rejected before running
an event is visible to a consumer before its recorded time
a forced late error fails to restore all owner state and the MuJoCo mjData
a subsequent successful tick differs from a clean control run
the native runner requires Python callbacks during a tick
scope: A tiny synthetic neuron and one-axis MuJoCo fixture, not the 166700-neuron model. No organism speed or stage admission.
